messages:
Noah P: Hi team — noticed my on-call stipend for July shows state tax withheld to both CA and VT (CA $30, VT $18). I live in CA, but covered a VT account for two weeks. I thought stipends were taxed as regular wages only in your residence state?
Lena (People Ops): Thanks for the heads up. Can you DM a screenshot of the paystub and confirm whether you updated your temporary work location in Workday or calendar?
Noah P: DMed screenshot. I added a temporary work location for VT in the internal calendar but did not change Workday.
Marco - Payroll: Pulling the record. Our payroll engine picks up geo-coded client assignments from the time-entry feed for certain paycodes (on-call/field stipend). When a client site with a different state appears in the feed, the system may attach a jurisdiction tag that triggers local/state taxation rules. In this case the VT tag created an additional state-level tax line.
Noah P: So will this change my W-2? I file CA as my resident state and don't want to deal with two state returns.
Marco - Payroll: Likely outcome: we can reverse the VT withholding via an off-cycle if no VT withholding liability legally applies (if you were not performing work physically in VT or not a VT tax resident). If VT taxes were incorrectly withheld and no employer remit occurred, reversal will correct YTD and should prevent a VT W-2 line. If VT received a remit, TaxOps will need to coordinate refund filing.
TaxOps Bot: Case TAX-5002 opened: "On-call stipend jurisdiction tag - Noah P". ETA 3 business days for audit.
Lena (People Ops): We'll wait for the TAX-5002 audit. Marco, can payroll also add a one-time mapping rule to ignore calendar-assigned client sites for stipend paycodes unless Workday residence changes? We've had similar false positives.
Marco - Payroll: Agree. I'll request a mapping exception for stipend paycodes and tag it as urgent. If audit confirms no VT remit, I'll process an off-cycle reversal and post details here.
Noah P: Thanks — appreciate the quick help. Will watch for TAX-5002 updates and any mail from VT. :pray:
